name: Catalogue of Life ChecklistBank API
summary: Global species checklist: accepted names, synonyms and classification for known organisms, plus other taxonomic checklists.
description: ChecklistBank hosts the Catalogue of Life (monthly releases, 5.4 million names in the 2026-10 release per /dataset/3LR) and thousands of other checklists. The API offers name usage search, taxon records with classification, name matching, datasets and exports. Dataset key 3LR is the latest COL release.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented in the pages fetched; fair use.

endpoints.summary: Full text search of names in a dataset
Match a scientific name to a usage

license.name: CC BY 4.0 (site content; dataset licenses vary per checklist)

agent_notes: Dataset key 3LR always points to the latest Catalogue of Life release; use a numeric key for a fixed version. Name search returns the full classification with each hit, so responses are large: use limit. Checklists other than COL have their own licenses.
caveats: Responses embed audit fields and the full classification, so even limit=1 is several KB.
Dataset licenses differ per checklist; only the site statement of CC BY 4.0 was confirmed today.
Authentication exists for editing; reads need none.
